title: Insurance claim
goal: Show policy validation, fraud risk, and settlement.

rubric.must: Claim and Settlement notice are dashed message flows between Policyholder and Insurer pools.
Covered? and Fraud risk? are exclusive gateways with alternative flows.
Claims, Fraud, and Settlement lanes are visible.
Claim received is a message start event and Settled and Declined are end events.
Assess damage visibly precedes fraud-risk decision.

ideal.notes: Independent reference drawing following visual-eval/exemplars/bpmn/collaboration/ideal.svg (sha256 8de8bd2f08be). Vision reviewed all six rasterized targets: neutral process palette, event and task markers, swimlanes, separate conditional/default routes and pool-boundary message arrows; fixed wire-body overlaps and gateway caption collisions. Source and rubric unchanged; no engine rendering used as target.
